page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4.4xlarge is an x86_64 storage-focused server instance within the Local SSDs family, running on the KVM hypervisor. Compute capacity is delivered through 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system provides 128.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, paired with a baseline network bandwidth profile of 10 Gbps without bundled public IPv4 addresses.

Storage architecture is defined by an integrated 3839 GB local solid-state drive (SSD). Because this substantial capacity is physically attached locally to the host, it eliminates network storage hops, targeting systems that need low-latency I/O operations directly at the block layer. There are no discrete hardware accelerators or GPUs configured on this server type.

Given its combination of a 1:8 core-to-memory ratio, integrated high-capacity local SSD storage, and 10 Gbps networking, the instance suits transactional databases, NoSQL clusters, search indexing nodes, distributed cache systems, and real-time analytical workloads requiring rapid access to high volumes of local data.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4.4xlarge is an x86_64 storage-oriented instance from the Local SSDs family, operating on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 16 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz, 128.0 GB of RAM, and 3839 GB of attached local SSD storage. Delivering an 8.0 GB per-vCPU memory allocation and a 10 Gbps baseline network throughput, this instance delivers dense local storage coupled with substantial memory capacity without hardware GPU acceleration. The tight coupling of high memory density and extensive fast local block storage positions the instance well for I/O-intensive workloads, including relational databases, distributed NoSQL databases, search engines, and real-time data streaming nodes requiring low data-access latency.
